spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Unmeasured, boundless, infinite.
2 Neglected, unpolished, unclean.
E.
अ neg. मित measured.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
Mighty, all-powerful, almighty.
E.
अमित boundless, ओजस् strength.

m. (-त्रः)
An enemy, an adversary.
mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
Unfriendly, hostile.
E.
अम to go, and इत्र Uṇādi affix, or अ neg. and मित्र a friend.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Sick, diseased.
E.
अम sickness, इनि aff.

mfn. (-श्रः-श्रा-श्रं)
Unmixed, unmixing.
E.
अ neg. मिश्र mixture.

mfn. (-यः-यां-यं)
Immiscible.
E.
अ neg. मिश्रणीय to be mixed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unmixed.
E.
अ neg. मिश्रित mixed.

Luxury.
2

Honesty, simplicity.
E.
अम to be sick, इषन् Uṇādi aff.

Flesh.
2

Enjoyment.
3

An object of enjoyment, a pleasing or beautiful object, &c.
4 A bribe.
5 Coveting, longing for.
6

Form.
7

Lust, desire.
8 Food.
E.
अम to be sick, to go, ष्टिसच् Uṇādi affix and the antepen. lengthened.

f. (-सा)
Absence of reasoning or investigation.
E.
अ neg. मीमांसा investigation by reason.

Sin.
2
Pain.

f. (-क्षा)
Curd of two milk whey.
E.
आङ्, मिष to sprinkle, सक् affix; also आमीक्षा.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
Made of curds, &c.
E.
आमिक्षा and यत् affix; also with छ, आमिक्षीय.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Carnivorous, fond of flesh meat.
m. (-यः)
A heron.
E.
आमिष flesh, and प्रिय fond of.

mfn. (-भुक्)
Carnivorous.
E.
आमिष and भुज् what eats.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Carnivorous, eating flesh and fish.
E.
आमिष flesh, अश to eat, and णिनि aff.
